title: Setup URI
description: Schema for remote-everything://setup URI query parameters. Shared by Go, Kotlin, Swift, and ArkTS strict parsers.

v.description: Protocol version. Only version 2 is supported.

name.description: Human-readable computer name. 1–80 Unicode code points, no C0 or DEL control characters.

mode.description: Connection mode: lan (LAN with certificate pinning) or public (internet with mTLS).

origin.description: Gateway HTTPS origin: scheme, host, optional port only; no path, query, or fragment.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the gateway TLS certificate. Required for LAN mode, absent for public mode.

public_key_pin.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 digest of the gateway certificate SubjectPublicKeyInfo. Required for LAN mode, absent for public mode.

invitation.description: Base64url invitation token. Required for public mode, absent for LAN mode.
